previousName.description: The name the member had before this update, when the update renames it; its stored value moves with it.

BoxRetention.description: What happens to a session's box after each of its turns, whatever the turn's outcome. A snapshot follows every turn in each mode.

Channel.SupervisorUpdateFailed.description:
The host's supervisor update stopped. `detail` states what failed and what fixes it.
`outputTail` holds the last lines the candidate printed in its dry run, token-shaped runs
hidden, and is empty for every other reason.

Channel.SupervisorUpdateStep.description:
The host's supervisor update from the binary `fromSha256` to `toSha256` entered `phase`. The new
binary sends Online once it reaches Welcome after the swap.

Connector.description: A connector of either credential kind.

ConnectorAccessToken.description:
An access token for one connector of one running turn. The forwarder sends it upstream until
fewer than 30 seconds remain before expiresAt, then fetches another. A token without expiresAt is
fetched once.

ConnectorAuth.description: How a connector's upstream credential is held: one static token, or an OAuth grant.

authorizeUrl.description: The provider's authorization page, with the control plane's callback, this authorization's PKCE S256 challenge, its signed state and the resource.

callbackDueAt.description: When the callback must arrive by, or the connector reads AuthorizationFailed AuthorizationExpired.

ConnectorAuthorization.description:
One OAuth authorization of a connector. Open authorizeUrl in a browser; the provider sends the
browser back to the control plane's callback, which stores the grant. Connectors_get reads the
outcome. A newer authorization of the same connector replaces this one.

detail.description: What failed and what fixes it, with the provider's answer sanitized; it never quotes a token response.

ConnectorAuthorizationFailureReason.description: Why an OAuth connector's authorization or refresh failed after authorize answered. Each reason names the phase it stopped in.

ConnectorStatus.description: Whether a connector serves new turns, with when it connected, when it was disconnected, or why its authorization failed.

ConnectorUrl.description:
The HTTPS address of a remote MCP server that speaks Streamable HTTP. It carries no user info, no
query and no fragment, so it never holds a credential.

expiresAt.description: When the access token in the file stops working. Shown only: the harness refreshes the file itself, so a turn is not refused for it.
When the access token in the file stops working. Shown only: the harness refreshes the file itself, so a turn is not refused for it.

previousName.description: The name the member had before this update, when the update renames it; its stored value moves with it.

HarnessPin.description: The harness version a tenant runs for one harness. It names an entry of the harness catalog.

HarnessPinCreate.description: The harness version a tenant runs for one harness. It names an entry of the harness catalog.

OAuthConnector.description:
A remote MCP server the tenant connects once through OAuth. An Owner authorizes it in a browser,
the control plane holds the grant sealed and refreshes it, and every session in the tenant whose
persona lists it reaches it through the box's loopback forwarder. The URL is fixed at create.

PersonaFilePath.description: A path relative to the harness home in the box, such as .claude/settings.json. The harness catalog lists the paths each harness accepts.

PersonaFileSize.description: The size of a persona file in bytes, at most PersonaFileLimit.PersonaBytes.

SecretKey.description: One member of a secret set, without its value. The value never leaves the control plane in a response.

SecretMemberUpdate.description: One member of a secret set update: a new value, or none to keep the value stored under its name or its previousName.

SecretName.description: The name of a secret set member, which is also the environment variable a box gets its value in.

SecretSet.description: A named set of secrets: at most one credential per provider, and any number of variables. Values are write-only.

SecretSetCreate.description: A named set of secrets: at most one credential per provider, and any number of variables. Values are write-only.

SecretSetUpdate.description:
Sets the set's name and its list of members. A member the update leaves out is deleted with its
value. A member sent without a value keeps the value stored under its previousName, or under its
name when it is not renamed.

SecretValue.description: One member of a secret set with its value, written once and never read back.

value.description: The new value of the member. Left out, the member keeps the value it has stored.

previousName.description: The name the member had before this update, when the update renames it; its stored value moves with it.

Sha256Digest.description: A lower-case hex SHA-256 digest: the name of a file in the image cache, or of a persona file blob.

StaticConnector.description:
A remote MCP server the tenant connects once with one static token. Every session in the tenant
whose persona lists it reaches it through the box's loopback forwarder, which sends the token as
Authorization: Bearer. The URL is fixed at create; the token is write-only.

expiresAt.description: When the token stops working. A turn offered at or after it fails CredentialExpired.
When the token stops working. A turn offered at or after it fails CredentialExpired.

value.description: The new value of the member. Left out, the member keeps the value it has stored.

SupervisorUpdateFailureReason.description: Why a supervisor update stopped. Every one but SupervisorUpdateRolledBack leaves the running binary in place.

SupervisorUpdateFailureReport.description:
A host's supervisor update that stopped. `detail` states what failed and what fixes it.
`outputTail` holds the last lines the candidate printed in its dry run, token-shaped runs
hidden, and is empty for every other reason.

SupervisorUpdateFailureReported.description: The latest supervisor update failure the host reported.

SupervisorUpdateNotReported.description: The host has reported no supervisor update step, or no failure, since it enrolled.

SupervisorUpdatePhase.description:
The phase a supervisor update entered. Fetching downloads and verifies the candidate binary,
DryRunning runs it with `check` beside the running binary and keeps it once it passes, Staged
is what supervisors before the box handover send while a candidate waits for the host to run no
box, Restarting swaps the binaries, parks every running turn and execs the new one, which takes
over the running boxes, and Online is the new binary reaching Welcome. WaitingForIdle is what supervisors before the idle claim send between DryRunning and
Restarting; the control plane accepts it and records nothing.

SupervisorUpdateStepReport.description:
A phase a host's supervisor update entered: from the binary `fromSha256` to `toSha256` of the
release `releaseVersion`, at `at`. `boxesRunning` counts the boxes the host ran as it entered
the phase; on Staged, the boxes the swap waits on, and on Restarting, the boxes handed over.

SupervisorUpdateStepReported.description: The latest supervisor update phase the host reported.

TenantApi.ConfigWrite.description: One write of a config apply, which the tenant Durable Object commits with the others in one transaction.

TenantApi.ConnectorStateClaims.description: The signed state of a connector authorization, as the callback reads it back.

TenantApi.GitHubUser.description: The GitHub account a repository token secret acts as, when the set holds one.

TenantApi.PersonaChange.description: What a persona edit writes. The harness is fixed at create.

value.description: Null when no persona has the id.

TenantApi.SecretSetUnreadable.description: A stored member no longer matches its kind, so the set cannot be read.

TenantApi.StoredFile.description: A persona file as the tenant Durable Object stores it: the bytes live in the store under `digest`.

TenantApi.StoredFileRead.description: A stored persona file with its timestamps, as a persona read carries it.

TenantApi.StoredPersona.description: A persona as the tenant Durable Object stores it, its files named by digest.

TenantApi.SupervisorUpdates.description: The latest update step and failure a host reported.

TenantApi.TenantApiVersionUnsupported.description: The request names a version outside the instance's window, or an older version an adapter cannot translate. The caller answers a retryable failure.

TenantApi.TenantOperationUnknown.description: The instance does not know the operation: it runs older code. The caller answers a retryable failure.

TenantApi.TenantRefusal.description: Why the tenant Durable Object served no result.

TenantApi.TenantRequest.description: One request to the tenant Durable Object's single entry point. `operation` names the operation the way a path names a REST operation.

TenantApi.TenantRequestInvalid.description: The input fails the operation's schema: a caller bug, which the caller fails as a 500.

TenantApi.WriteConflict.description: A unique constraint refused the write.

TenantApiProtocol.description:
The Tenant API versions the tenant Durable Object serves, from Oldest to Version. A caller always
sends Version. Within a version only a new operation lands; every other change to an operation's
input or result raises Version, and the Durable Object keeps serving Version - 1 for one deploy.
